title: CMMC Level 2 Readiness & Assessment Prep on Google Workspace (NIST SP 800-171)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Workspace administration/governance/compliance).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity authored at exact detail from Google public docs; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Regulatory/compliance INTERPRETATION (CMMC assessment outcomes, NIST 800-171 applicability, ITAR/DFARS determinations, C3PAO assessment scheduling) is deferred to the organization's compliance/legal/assessor — the solution provides the technical control mapping, configuration method, and evidence, not the certification determination. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Get Google Workspace ready for CMMC Level 2 assessment
problem: Defense-supply-chain organizations handling CUI on Google Workspace must meet CMMC Level 2 — the 110 NIST SP 800-171 controls — and be ready for a C3PAO assessment. This solution is the readiness playbook: map the applicable NIST 800-171 controls to Google Workspace capabilities (Assured Controls, access, DLP, logging, encryption), configure and evidence them, define the CUI boundary, and build the SSP and POA&M — so the tenant is configured, evidenced, and assessment-ready. Certification determinations stay with your assessor/compliance team.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — CMMC L2 and the NIST 800-171 control families, the CUI boundary on Google Workspace, Assured Controls / GCC enablement, and the SSP/POA&M/evidence model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Workspace edition supporting Assured Controls/GCC, CUI scope, compliance/assessor stakeholders, data map).

Implementation Guide — define the CUI boundary, map NIST 800-171 controls to Workspace configuration, apply and evidence the controls (access, DLP, logging, encryption, MFA), and build the SSP + POA&M — pilot-first; assessment/certification determinations deferred to the C3PAO/compliance.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or operations helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health or control check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (controls configured + evidenced, SSP/POA&M complete, boundary enforced) plus Best Practices; NIST 800-171 references cited, assessment outcomes not asserted.
short: Get Google Workspace CMMC Level 2 assessment-ready — NIST SP 800-171 control mapping, CUI boundary, Assured Controls/GCC configuration + evidence, and the SSP & POA&M — so the tenant is configured, evidenced, and ready for a C3PAO. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
